test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 9 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Reluctant
solution:
The correct answer is Hesitant.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word 'reluctant' is 'unwilling and hesitant; disinclined'.
 
• Let's consider each option-
 
 
• Definite- Having certain or distinct limits
 
• Hesitant- **Tentative, unsure**, or slow in acting or speaking.
 
• Confident- Feeling or showing confidence in oneself or one's abilities or qualities.
 
• Indiscreet- Having, showing, or proceeding from too great a readiness to reveal things that should remain private or secret.
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate synonym of the word 'reluctant' is 'hesitant'.
 
• Thus, option 2 is the correct answer.
